description.summary: the session agent's link to the compositor

protocol.description:
The compositor runs as its own system user and cannot read the user's files or start programs as the user. Each logged-in user runs one session agent, crown-session, which does both on the compositor's behalf: it pushes the user's configuration and starts whatever the compositor asks for, from keybindings or the startup list.
The global is only advertised to clients on a user session's own listener that did not come through a security context.
Warning! The protocol described in this file is currently in the testing phase. Backward compatible changes may be added together with the corresponding interface version bump. Backward incompatible changes can only be done by creating a new major version of the extension.

interface.name: crownos_session_v1
interface.description: A single global per session. Binding it twice from one client is a protocol error.

entry.name: invalid_config
entry.summary: the config payload could not be read

request.name: set_config
request.description: A file descriptor to a sealed memfd holding the configuration bundle (RON, as crownpositor's config crate encodes it), size bytes long. Sent once after binding and again whenever a config file changes.

request.name: ready

description.summary: the startup programs have been started

request.description: The compositor may start revealing the desktop once the session's wallpaper and panels have drawn, or after a short timeout.

event.name: spawn

description.summary: start a program as the user

event.description: argv is NUL-separated, each argument followed by one NUL.

event.name: save_outputs
event.description: The user rearranged or reconfigured monitors. fd is a memfd of size bytes holding the RON tuple (outputs, output_layouts), to be merged into the user's compositor.ron.

event.name: logout
event.description: The agent should stop its programs and exit, which closes the session.
